1339-2835-3899.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
1339-2835-3899.description:
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Fecundity triggers, causing you to draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Repeat.

1479-2841-4488-8103.easyPrerequisites:
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Verdant Catacombs.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
1479-2841-4488-8103.description:
Fetch a land using Verdant Catacombs.
When the fetched land enters, Rampaging Baloths and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Rampaging Baloths trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Rampaging Baloths from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Rampaging Baloths triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

3899-6972-7236.easyPrerequisites: The total toughness of creatures you control excluding Towering Titan is at least X.
3899-6972-7236.description:
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Towering Titan.
When Towering Titan dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Repeat.

3525-6006-8039.description:
Activate Spireside Infiltrator by tapping it, adding {U}.
Spireside Infiltrator triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent
Activate Pemmin's Aura by paying {U}, untapping Spireside Infiltrator.
Repeat.

511-817-1270-4050-7803.notablePrerequisites: Brad Boimler has been tapped this turn.
511-817-1270-4050-7803.description:
Activate Fungal Bloom by paying {G}{G}, putting two spore counters on Sporoloth Ancient due to Brad Boimler.
Activate Sporoloth Ancient by removing two spore counters from it, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token plus an additional two creature tokens due to Ojer Taq, Deepest Foundation.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing two creature tokens, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat from step 1.

1263-4871-6026-6798.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Bloodsoaked Champion.
When Bloodsoaked Champion dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Field of Souls trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Bloodsoaked Champion by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

413-4535--5.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the persist creature enters, Blasting Station and Good-Fortune Unicorn trigger.
Resolve the Good-Fortune Unicorn trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on the persist creature.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1.
Repeat

2292-2744--5.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the persist creature enters, Cathars' Crusade triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat

uses.n: Heliod, the Radiant Dawn // Heliod, the Warped Eclipse

1965-2034-4668-5224.notablePrerequisites: Opponents have drawn at least one card this turn.
1965-2034-4668-5224.description:
Cast Omarthis by paying at most {1}, causing it to enter the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Together Forever by paying {1}, targeting Omarthis.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Omarthis, adding {C}{C}.
When Omarthis dies, Together Forever triggers, returning Omarthis from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

4871-5147-5220-5651.notablePrerequisites: You control a nontoken creature that can be cast using one colored mana.
4871-5147-5220-5651.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing the nontoken creature.
When the creature dies, Mortuary and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting the creature from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Cast the creature from the top of your library by paying its mana cost
Repeat.

851-1563-3899-6968.description:
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by paying {1} and removing two charge counters from it, creating two creature tokens
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability twice by sacrificing the tokens, putting two charge counters on Spawning Pit.
Repeat.

549-1978-5457.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three creatures with different powers.
549-1978-5457.description:
Activate Selvala by tapping it, adding at least {3}.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Selvala.
Repeat

4251-4885-6911.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
4251-4885-6911.description:
Declare Godo as an attacker, triggering its ability, causing you to untap it and all Samurai you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Godo, triggering Impostor Syndrome, creating a token copy of Godo that isn't legendary.
When the Godo token enters, it triggers, allowing you to search your library for an Equipment and put it onto the battlefield.
During your next combat phase, declare Godo and the Godo token as attackers.
The Godo token triggers, causing you to untap it and all Samurai you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat from step 2.

1432-3746.easyPrerequisites: There is at least one other legendary creature on the battlefield.
1432-3746.description:
Activate Robaran Mercenaries using Ioreth's second ability by tapping it, untapping Ioreth and another legendary creature.
Activate Ioreth's first ability by tapping it, untapping Robaran Mercenaries.
Repeat.

requires.n: Extra Turn Spell - GY on Resolution

1809-5256-6490--88.notablePrerequisites:
You have enough mana available each turn to cast the extra turn spell and enough mana each extra turn to cast Returned Pastcaller.
You have not cast a spell using Kotis
1809-5256-6490--88.description:
Cast the extra turn spell by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your extra turn.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Returned Pastcaller, causing you to mill cards equal to Returned Pastcaller's power.
Cast Returned Pastcaller from your graveyard by paying its mana cost and exiling three other cards from your graveyard, ensuring not to exile the extra turn spell.
When Returned Pastcaller enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning the extra turn spell from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

uses.n: Birgi, God of Storytelling // Harnfel, Horn of Bounty

392-2438-5173-5258-5618.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Shambling Ghast.
When Shambling Ghast dies, it and Rakdos trigger.
Resolve the Shambling Ghast trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Holding priority, activate Haunted Crossroads by paying {B}, putting Shambling Ghast from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Rakdos trigger, exiling Shambling Ghast from the top of your library with the ability to cast it until your next turn.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Shambling Ghast from exile by paying {1}.
Birgi triggers, adding {R}.
Repeat.

1247-1656-3772.notablePrerequisites: Necrotic Ooze does not have summoning sickness.
1247-1656-3772.description:
Activate Necrotic Ooze using Omen Hawker's ability by tapping it, adding {C}{U} that can only be spent to activate abilities.
Activate Necrotic Ooze using Pili-Pala's ability by paying {2} and untapping it, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat.

645-914-2292-3750.notablePrerequisites:
Alesha does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent cannot block and kill creatures you control.
Opponents control at least seven artifacts and/or enchantments.
645-914-2292-3750.description:
Declare Alesha as an attacker.
Alesha triggers, causing you to pay {W/B}{W/B} to return Dockside Extortionist from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped and attacking.
When Dockside Extortionist enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating at least seven Treasure tokens.
Move to your postcombat main phase.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Dockside Extortionist, causing you to scry 1.
Activate five Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {3}{R}{R}.
Activate Aggravated Assault by paying {3}{R}{R}, causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat and main phase after this one.
Move to your next combat phase.
Declare Alesha as an attacker.
Alesha triggers, holding priority, activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {W/B}{W/B}.
Resolve the Alesha trigger, causing you to pay {W/B}{W/B} to return Dockside Extortionist from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped and attacking.
Repeat from step 3.

1560-1853-2029-3953.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is at least three.
1560-1853-2029-3953.description:
Activate Unbridled Growth by sacrificing it.
Mazzy triggers, exiling Unbridled Growth and allowing you to cast it from exile until the end of your next turn.
Resolve the Unbridled Growth ability, causing you to draw a card.
Cast Unbridled Growth from exile by paying 2 life.
Dawnhart Geist and Defiler of Vigor trigger.
Resolve the Defiler of Vigor trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Resolve the Dawnhart Geist trigger, causing you to gain two life.
Resolve Unbridled Growth, attaching it to any land you control.
Repeat.

628-4073-4465.notablePrerequisites: Basal Sliver does not have a +1/+1 counter on it.
628-4073-4465.description:
Activate Basal Sliver by sacrificing it, adding {B}{B}.
Basal Sliver dies, triggering its undying ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Retribution of the Ancients by paying {B} and removing the +1/+1 counter from Basal Sliver, targeting any creature.
Repeat.

2034-2308-2685-3263.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to gain any amount of life.
2034-2308-2685-3263.description:
Gain any amount of life.
Trudge Garden triggers, causing you to pay {2} to create a 4/4 Fungus Beast creature token that is also an artifact due to Mycosynth Lattice.
The Fungus Beast enters the battlefield, triggering Teething Wurmlet.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Fungus Beast, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Teething Wurmlet trigger, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

647-890-4659-5003.notablePrerequisites: Nim Deathmantle attached to Palladium Myr.
647-890-4659-5003.description:
Activate Palladium Myr by tapping it, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Palladium Myr, adding {C}{C}.
Palladium Myr dies, triggering Nim Deathmantle, causing you to pay {4} to return Palladium Myr from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
Repeat.

3774-4013-4659-5287.notablePrerequisites: Dihada has at least four loyalty counters on it.
3774-4013-4659-5287.description:
Activate Dihada's second loyalty ability by removing three loyalty counters from it, causing you to mill four cards and create four Treasure tokens.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks twice by sacrificing three Treasure tokens, adding six {C}.
Activate Luxior's first equip ability by paying {1}, attaching it to Dihada, causing Dihada to become a creature that is no longer a planeswalker.
Activate Eldrazi Displacer by paying {2}{C}, blinking Dihada.
Repeat.

600-1887.description:
Cast Jace by paying {1}{U}{U}. Jace enters the battlefield with six loyalty counters due to Vorinclex
Activate Jace's third loyalty ability by removing five loyalty counters from it, creating two nonlegendary copies of Jace that enter the battlefield with six loyalty counters each due to Vorinclex.
Repeat step 2 using a Jace token.
600-1887.notes: Once you have infinite Jace tokens, you may activate their second loyalty abilities by removing two loyalty counters from them, creating infinite 2/2 Illusion creature tokens.

278-5203.description:
Cast Lay Claim by {5}{U}{U}, targeting any permanent on the battlefield.
Holding priority, cast Radiant Performer by paying {3}{R}{R}.
Radiant Performer enters the battlefield, creating a copy of Lay Claim for each other permanent on the battlefield.
Resolve each Lay Claim, causing you to gain control of all permanents.

687-2034-2086-5319.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Geralf's Messenger, adding {C}{C}.
When Geralf's Messenger dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 and a vigilance counter on it.
When Geralf's Messenger enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing target opponent to lose 2 life.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Kitchen Finks, adding {C}{C}.
When Kitchen Finks dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 and a vigilance counter on it.
When Kitchen Finks enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to gain 2 life.
Activate Tayam by paying {3} and removing the +1/+1 counter from Geralf's Messenger, the -1-1 counter from Kitchen Finks, and a vigilance counter from any creature you control, milling yourself three cards then returning any permanent card with mana value 3 or less from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.
